description: Labeled questions for the retrieval-only eval (plan 3.1 to 3.4). Each case names the sources that answer it. Only Tirath marks a case reviewed (G2) and decides its split (G3).

label_format.accept: ecfr:34-<section> (or fr:/reggov: ids) for a regulation; hb:<heading prefix> or hb:<document>|<heading prefix> for a handbook section
label_format.in_library: true if the answering source is in the searchable library (eCFR or imported handbook chapters); false if not; null until labeled
label_format.split: build cases may be used to tune; held-out cases never are. Every build case here came from a suite already used in tuning.
